tagline.en: O2-based UK MVNO — 6-month activity keep-alive, eSIM only after physical-SIM conversion
tagline.zh: O2网络英国虚商——每半年使用保号，eSIM须先实体卡再转换

description.en: Tesco Mobile is a 50/50 JV between retailer Tesco and O2, running on O2's network (99% 4G population coverage, 5G supported) across the UK, Ireland, Slovakia and Czechia. Entry eSIM route: order a £10/12GB plan with a physical SIM, then convert to eSIM — the website does not support direct eSIM selection. Keep-alive: one usage record every 6 months.
description.zh: Tesco Mobile是零售巨头Tesco与O2各持股50%的合资虚商，走O2网络（4G覆盖99%人口，支持5G），在英国、爱尔兰、斯洛伐克和捷克提供服务。入门路径：订购10英镑/12GB套餐并先拿实体SIM，再转换为eSIM——官网不支持在线直接选eSIM。保号：每6个月内有一次使用记录（拨打电话、发短信、计费通信等）。

details.en:
Tesco Mobile's profile is retail-brand trust on O2 infrastructure: 99% 4G coverage claim with 5G, monthly and PAYG plans, and a keep-alive cadence of one usage record per 6 months.

The friction is eSIM onboarding: the site cannot sell eSIM directly — you order a plan bundled with a physical SIM (entry around £10/12GB), then convert inside the account/app afterwards. That makes it the least eSIM-friendly of the reviewed UK options and awkward for buyers outside the UK who cannot easily receive a physical card.

Once converted, it behaves like the other budget MVNOs: priority below O2's own subscribers, monthly-or-PAYG flexibility, and a China-roaming story the source review does not emphasise — group it with the low-cost/flexible tier rather than the China-roaming specialists.
details.zh:
Tesco Mobile的卖点是零售品牌信任度+O2网络设施：宣称4G覆盖99%人口并支持5G，月付与Paygo并存，保号节奏为每6个月一次使用记录。

摩擦在eSIM入手：官网不能直接卖eSIM——须先订购搭配实体SIM的套餐（入门约10英镑/12GB），之后在账户/App内转换。这使它成为本轮英国选项中对eSIM最不友好的一个，对不在英国、难收实体卡的用户尤其别扭。

转换后与其他低价虚商无异：优先级低于O2本网用户、月付/Paygo灵活，源盘点也未强调其中国漫游能力——归入「低价灵活」梯队而非回国漫游专用梯队。

bestFor.en: UK-based shoppers who like the Tesco brand and can do the physical-SIM-to-eSIM conversion.
bestFor.zh: 人在英国、认可Tesco品牌并能完成实体卡转eSIM的用户。
